subjects.name: Report Writing & Communication Skills
subjects.description: Essential professional and engineering communication skills, technical report writing, presentation techniques, and collaborative team communication.

subjects.name: Mathematics I
subjects.description: Differential calculus, limits, derivatives, applications of derivatives, curves, series expansions, and analytical geometry.

subjects.name: Vibration & Waves
subjects.description: Simple harmonic motion, mechanical oscillations, damped and forced vibrations, acoustic and electromagnetic waves, sound interference.

subjects.name: Introduction to Computer Systems
subjects.description: Fundamentals of hardware and computer architectures, operating systems, algorithm logic, problem-solving, and online software tools.

subjects.name: Engineering Chemistry
subjects.description: Electrochemistry and corrosion, industrial water treatment, fuels, combustion, engineering polymers, and chemical laboratory experiments.

subjects.name: Statics
subjects.description: Equilibrium of 2D and 3D force systems, moments, centroids, analysis of simple trusses, frames, machines, and friction.

subjects.name: Engineering Drawing
subjects.description: Technical geometric drafting, orthographic projections, isometric drawing, sectional views, dimensioning standards, and SolidWorks 3D CAD modeling.
